rounds.title: Light selected row tint
rounds.note: Q93: in the light scheme the selected row is a 16 % mint tint (--et-theme-color-primary), 1.08:1 against the white panel, so it barely stands out; the label ink (--et-theme-color-ink, 4 120 87) is 5.07:1 on it (hover 24 % 4.90, active 32 % 4.74). The round raises the tint in the light scheme only, no edge bar; the dark scheme keeps 16/24/32. Ceiling: the ink drops under 4.5:1 above a 47 % tint, so a mint tint can reach about 1.22:1 against the panel at most, and the hover/active steps shrink as the base tint grows.

a.note: Selected 24 % / hover 32 % / active 40 %. Fill vs panel 1.12 / 1.16 / 1.19:1; label ink vs fill 4.90 / 4.74 / 4.61:1. Keeps today's +8/+16 steps.

b.note: Pick. Selected 32 % / hover 38 % / active 44 %. Fill vs panel 1.16 / 1.18 / 1.20:1; label ink vs fill 4.74 / 4.64 / 4.56:1. Twice today's tint, and hover and active still read as steps above it with ink margin left.

c.note: Selected 40 % / hover 43 % / active 46 %. Fill vs panel 1.19 / 1.20 / 1.21:1; label ink vs fill 4.61 / 4.57 / 4.53:1. Strongest rest tint, but hover and active are barely distinguishable from it and the ink sits at the 4.5 edge.
